title: FDA approves first treatment to reduce risk of serious heart problems specifically in adults with obesity or overweight
journal: US Food and Drug Administration, news release, 8 March 2024
result: FDA approved a new Wegovy indication to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death, heart attack and stroke in adults with cardiovascular disease and either obesity or overweight, on the basis of a trial of more than 17,600 participants in which major adverse cardiovascular events occurred in 6.5% on Wegovy against 8% on placebo, both groups receiving standard care and lifestyle counselling. The indication received Priority Review and was granted to Novo Nordisk A/S.
